episode_profile.title: Building Secure AI Systems with Blockchain
episode_profile.topic_summary: Mrinal Manohar discusses the innovative integration of blockchain technology in AI governance, emphasizing the importance of tamper-proof records and compliance with emerging regulations. He explains how Casper Labs is developing a product called Prove AI to enhance data integrity and governance in AI systems.

key_arguments.claim: Blockchain provides the best form of tamper-proofing for AI governance.
key_arguments.speaker: Mrinal Manohar
key_arguments.context: Mrinal explains how blockchain's immutable records are essential for ensuring data integrity in AI systems.

key_arguments.claim: The EU AI Act will require AI systems to have a level of auditability similar to financial statements.
key_arguments.speaker: Mrinal Manohar
key_arguments.context: He discusses the implications of the EU AI Act and how it influences the development of Prove AI.

key_arguments.claim: Prove AI will integrate seamlessly with IBM's Watson X platform, enhancing its governance capabilities.
key_arguments.speaker: Mrinal Manohar
key_arguments.context: Mrinal describes the collaboration with IBM and how it strengthens the product's market position.

key_arguments.claim: Companies are currently managing AI governance manually, which is inefficient.
key_arguments.speaker: Mrinal Manohar
key_arguments.context: He highlights the need for automated solutions like Prove AI to streamline governance processes.

key_arguments.claim: The blockchain can enable automated triggers to shut down rogue AI systems.
key_arguments.speaker: Mrinal Manohar
key_arguments.context: He explains the potential for blockchain to act as a safety mechanism in AI governance.

key_arguments.claim: Casper Labs is ahead of competitors in developing end-to-end AI governance solutions.
key_arguments.speaker: Mrinal Manohar
key_arguments.context: Mrinal asserts that their early focus on AI governance positions them uniquely in the market.
